en.headline: Expert says many flu patients deteriorating faster this season, research under way
en.dek: Former Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases president Kwan Yat-wah noted higher influenza A activity and rapid worsening in some patients, including children with low blood pressure or encephalitis, and said researchers are examining possible viral gene changes.
body: Dr Kwan Yat-wah, former president and executive committee member of the Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases, said on Sunday that he had observed many influenza patients this season deteriorating more quickly than in previous years.

He noted that influenza A activity has been high recently. Some children infected with the virus have developed low blood pressure, diffuse bleeding or encephalitis, but the cause is not yet known. Researchers are examining whether viral gene changes may be involved.

Kwan advised parents and caregivers to watch for warning signs of severe illness, especially in children, including persistent high fever, vomiting, abdominal pain or chest pain, and to seek medical attention promptly so that antiviral treatment can be prescribed. He pointed out that the virus replicates and is shed heavily in the early stage of illness, making the first 48 hours after onset a key window for antiviral treatment.

He mentioned that a second-generation antiviral, baloxavir, requires only a single dose and can clear the virus in about 24 hours, and suggested that wider use in settings such as care homes, child-care centres and schools could help reduce environmental viral load and community transmission.

zh.headline: 關日華指今季流感患者病情轉差較快 正研究病毒基因變化
zh.dek: 亞洲兒童傳染病學會前會長關日華表示，近期甲型流感活躍，今季不少患者病情較快惡化，部分兒童出現血壓低、腦炎等，正研究是否與病毒基因改變有關。
body: 亞洲兒童傳染病學會前會長及執行委員會委員關日華周日表示，他觀察到今季不少流感患者病情轉差速度較往年快。
他指出，近期甲型流感發病率高。部分兒童感染後出現血壓低、彌漫性出血甚至腦炎，但成因暫未明確，正在研究是否與病毒基因改變有關。
關日華提醒，尤其兒童一旦感染，需留意重症警號，包括持續高燒、嘔吐、腹痛及胸口痛等，應及早求醫，由醫生處方抗病毒藥。他指出，流感發病初期病毒會大量複製及排出，發病後首48小時是抗病毒治療的重要時機。
他提到，第二代流感藥巴洛沙韋只需單次服用，約24小時可清除病毒，並建議在護老院、兒童照顧機構及學校等場所考慮使用，以降低環境病毒量及減少社區傳播。
